name: QuintoAndar
category: housing marketplace and transaction platform
headline_claim: Online rent, buy and sell workflow with a business ecosystem and data products; company reports 15,000+ new rental contracts monthly and 3,000+ monthly sales
caveats: Claims are company-reported; market-share and transaction numbers need independent verification; Brazil legal and payment rails do not transfer directly.

name: Loft
category: real-estate platform CRM credit and rental guarantee
business_model: software plus financial intermediation and guarantee
headline_claim: Integrates CRM, portals, digital signatures, rent guarantees, mortgage intermediation and rental administration; company reports 9,000+ partner agencies and R$10bn credit origination in 2024
caveats: Regulated credit/insurance functions and partner economics require local diligence; customer and origination metrics are company-reported.

name: La Haus
category: new-home marketplace and developer transaction platform
headline_claim: Connects buyers with verified new-home developers and performs legal/reputational and title checks on projects
caveats: Verification badges and investor claims are not proof of legal title or project delivery; Colombia and Mexico workflows differ from Bangladesh.

name: Habi
category: instant home-buying and data-enabled resale platform
business_model: principal purchase resale and transaction services
headline_claim: Uses technology and data to buy homes directly, renovate and resell; expanded from Colombia into Mexico
caveats: Principal inventory creates underwriting and working-capital risk; current operating scope and outcomes need financial verification.

name: Houm
category: all-in-one residential marketplace and management
headline_claim: Digital workflow for renting, buying, selling and managing homes across three Latin American markets; company reports 20,000+ owners
caveats: Owner and property metrics are company claims; country-specific tenancy, collections and service quality must be rechecked.

name: Clau
category: real-estate super-app marketplace CRM mortgage and data
headline_claim: YC describes a Mexican marketplace, broker CRM, mortgage brokerage, renovation services and residential data layer
caveats: YC directory description is not an audited operating or customer outcome report; current product breadth and licensing need recheck.

name: GoJom
category: one-stop real-estate marketplace and transaction services
headline_claim: YC describes a faster way to buy sell and rent property across Latin America using technology and machine learning
caveats: Early-stage directory evidence; verify countries, licensing, transaction volume and current operations before relying on it.

name: Property Finder
category: property marketplace data and agent technology
business_model: listing subscriptions data products and transaction services
headline_claim: MENA platform with transaction data, valuation and AI ranking products; official history reports Data Guru and SuperAgent launches and a 2025 investment round
claim_type: company product description and financing announcement
caveats: Funding and product claims are company-reported; portal leads are not the same as closed transactions; local data access is market-specific.

name: Dubizzle Group / Bayut
category: property classifieds market intelligence and agent workflow
business_model: listing subscriptions CRM data APIs and advertising
headline_claim: Bayut and dubizzle combine marketplace distribution with property intelligence, automated valuation, DLD-linked transactions and agent tools
claim_type: company product description and group disclosure
caveats: Bayut is a brand within Dubizzle Group; deduplicate group and brand in the website; investor and market-leadership claims need date labels.

name: Mubawab
category: North African property marketplace and market data
business_model: listing subscriptions advertising and transaction services
headline_claim: Digital property platform connecting buyers renters agencies and developers; official page reports 2m+ monthly visits and acquisition of Jumia House in the Maghreb
caveats: Traffic is company-reported and not equivalent to leads or closings; French/Arabic and country coverage are key localization variables.

name: Property24
operating_regions: South Africa and selected Africa markets
category: property portal and agent/developer marketing
headline_claim: South Africa portal with 300,000+ sale and rental listings claimed on its official about page and expansion signals in Kenya and Nigeria
caveats: Listing counts and international footprint change; parent ownership and market coverage should be stored separately from the brand.

name: Private Property Nigeria
category: property classified marketplace
headline_claim: Nigeria portal reporting 120,000+ properties and more than 1m monthly visitors on its official about page
caveats: Visitor and inventory claims are not independently audited; fraud controls and listing freshness are central to transferability.

name: Nigeria Property Centre
operating_regions: Nigeria Ghana Kenya Uganda and Ethiopia
category: pan-African property search platform
headline_claim: Official page reports 181,000+ active listings, 18,700 agents/developers, 698 areas and 1.25m monthly seekers across its network
caveats: Self-reported network metrics; country domains and market data should be separated; search traffic does not prove transaction conversion.

name: Estate Intel
category: real-estate market intelligence and project data
business_model: data subscriptions reports and custom research
headline_claim: Property and construction database covering historic prices vacancy project teams and project tracking; official site reports 120+ subscribing companies
caveats: Customer count and database coverage are company claims; validate data provenance, update cadence and local representativeness.

name: HouseAfrica
category: land verification digital title and fractional property platform
headline_claim: Uses satellite mapping, digital certificates and blockchain-linked records to improve land verification and payments in Africa
caveats: Live site and self-described partnerships are not proof of current solvency, regulatory authorization or enforceable title; classify status unresolved until independently verified.

name: Plentific
category: property operations maintenance procurement and compliance
headline_claim: Pi Labs describes Plentific as property-management software automating property operations; strong missing UK operations benchmark
caveats: Pi Labs listing establishes product and current portfolio presence, not audited customer outcomes; UK procurement and housing regulation require localization.

name: Qualis Flow
category: construction embodied-carbon measurement
headline_claim: Pi Labs describes software that decarbonizes construction from a photograph, making it a concrete missing construction-carbon benchmark
caveats: Product claims need project-level method and third-party LCA review; photo-based estimates are not a substitute for verified EPD or bill-of-material data.

name: Elyos AI
category: autonomous AI agents for trades and field services
headline_claim: Pi Labs lists Elyos AI as fully autonomous AI agents for trades and field services
caveats: Early-stage product and safety claims need live customer evidence, human approval controls and clear liability boundaries.

name: Kestrix
category: machine-learning energy surveying and building intelligence
headline_claim: Pi Labs lists Kestrix as machine-learning energy surveillance, a missing bridge between building data capture and retrofit decisions
caveats: Survey accuracy, retrofit savings and local climate calibration need independent validation; service-heavy delivery may limit scale.

name: Orbital Witness
category: AI-assisted title and property due diligence
headline_claim: Connects title registers, searches, leases and maps into a reviewable property record and orders official copies in bulk
caveats: UK Land Registry workflow is not portable to Bangladesh; legal advice, official-copy status and lawyer review must remain explicit.

name: Searchland
category: land sourcing planning ownership and infrastructure data
headline_claim: Combines planning ownership title constraints comparables energy and infrastructure data with APIs for sourcing and feasibility
caveats: UK datasets and Land Registry access are jurisdiction-specific; self-reported 2,000-user and productivity claims require validation.

name: Deepki
category: real-estate sustainability data climate risk and CapEx planning
headline_claim: Centralizes utility and sustainability data, climate risk, compliance, virtual retrofit and CapEx decisions; official site reports 600+ companies and 6,500+ buildings monitored
caveats: Reported 32% energy reduction and 40% reporting-time savings are company claims; Bangladesh utility factors and disclosure requirements differ.

name: Bentley Systems
category: infrastructure digital twins and engineering data platform
business_model: enterprise software licensing and cloud services
headline_claim: iTwin federates engineering BIM reality GIS IoT schedule and enterprise data into open-API infrastructure digital twins
claim_type: official product description and customer stories
caveats: Infrastructure-led rather than residential PropTech; implementation and proprietary schemas can create integration complexity.

name: Trimble
category: surveying BIM and connected construction management
headline_claim: Construction One connects project, field, financial, scheduling and equipment workflows across contractor types
caveats: Hardware, standards and implementation costs are significant; product portfolio and acquisitions should be tracked separately.

name: Hexagon
category: reality capture geospatial cadastral and construction QA
headline_claim: Combines reality capture, cadastral and geospatial data, autonomous sensors and deviation analysis for planning and construction QA
caveats: Status, brands and divisions can change after the 2026 Octave separation; local survey licensing and hardware service matter.

name: Nemetschek
category: open BIM design construction and building-management software
headline_claim: Portfolio covers planning, visualization, construction and building management through brands such as Bluebeam, Graphisoft, Solibri, Spacewell and dTwin
caveats: Group is a parent of many brands; do not count each brand as an independent company without ownership relationships.

name: Dusty Robotics
category: autonomous BIM-driven construction layout robot
headline_claim: FieldPrinter prints coordinated multi-trade BIM layout on slabs; official customer page reports deployment on hundreds of North American projects
claim_type: company product description and customer stories
caveats: Product is currently available in North America; case outcomes are customer/vendor-reported and local labor economics may differ.

name: Built Robotics
category: autonomous construction equipment and excavation systems
headline_claim: Develops autonomous construction equipment to automate earthmoving and jobsite work
caveats: Autonomy in live jobsites has safety, supervision, equipment and insurance requirements; validate deployments, not demonstrations.

name: ICON
category: robotic 3D-printed construction and BuildOS
business_model: hardware software materials training and construction services
headline_claim: BuildOS orchestrates robotic concrete printing and the company is rolling out Titan systems for builders
claim_type: company product description and rollout announcement
caveats: 3D printing solves only part of total construction cost; structural standards, finishes, utilities, code, service and economics need project-level proof.

name: FBR / Hadrian X
category: autonomous bricklaying and construction robotics
business_model: robotics hardware licensing and construction services
headline_claim: ASX-listed FBR develops Hadrian autonomous bricklaying and reports speeds up to 360 blocks per hour on its product page
caveats: Throughput is not the same as completed-house cost or quality; block supply, site setup, local standards and workforce model are decisive.

name: Pinhome
category: integrated property marketplace finance and home services
headline_claim: Indonesia property-tech platform serving seekers, owners, developers and maintenance users; company reports up to 1m unique listings and finance/service partners
caveats: Metrics are company-reported; marketplace, lending and home-service regulatory boundaries should be separated.

name: Travelio
category: online rental marketplace and professionally managed apartments
headline_claim: Technology platform supports rent, buy and sell plus Travelio Property Management for furnished and unfurnished units; official FAQ reports 8,000+ properties
caveats: Inventory is self-reported; short-term rental, tenancy, building rules and service-level economics are local.

name: Livspace
category: tech-enabled end-to-end interiors and renovation
business_model: marketplace design manufacturing installation and warranty
headline_claim: Integrates designer marketplace, materials, manufacturing, installation, warranty and project coordination; company reports 100,000+ homes and 100+ cities
caveats: Quality, deadline and warranty outcomes need independent validation; useful as a handover/fit-out benchmark, not a core developer ERP.

name: Propaya
category: AI extraction of CRE leases and property documents
headline_claim: YC describes extraction of lease terms obligations costs dates and risk signals with source citations and portfolio routing
caveats: Early-stage YC listing is not proof of production reliability or legal accuracy; document access and human review are essential.

name: Assembly HOA
category: AI-native HOA management and community operations
headline_claim: YC describes AI-enabled HOA management, routine-task automation and resident/board transparency
caveats: Service business plus software; HOA governance, legal duties and trust require human accountability.

name: RentFlow
category: AI cash-flow-synced commercial rent payments
headline_claim: YC describes underwriting business rent in real time from transaction data to prevent late payments
caveats: US SMB underwriting and payments are not portable to Bangladesh; regulated credit, defaults and consent need diligence.

name: inBuild
category: AI invoice approval payment and budget control for homebuilders
headline_claim: YC describes invoice checking against project budgets, approvals, payments and QuickBooks updates
caveats: Accounting integration and payment controls are US-centric; test segregation of duties and local tax treatment.

name: FlexDesk
category: AI corporate real-estate portfolio workflow
headline_claim: YC describes agents that execute fragmented corporate real-estate back-office and portfolio workflows; customer examples include Reddit and Confluent
caveats: Customer and automation claims are directory statements; integration, procurement and data-security requirements are enterprise-heavy.

name: PermitFlow
category: AI preconstruction and permit management
headline_claim: YC describes an AI platform helping contractors and developers manage preconstruction and permitting
caveats: Permitting is authority-specific; no Bangladesh data or workflow equivalence should be assumed.

name: WeReno
category: AI owner's representative for renovations and capital projects
headline_claim: YC describes drawing analysis, scopes, cost estimates, RFQs, vendor coordination and execution tracking
caveats: Construction drawings, trade pricing, contracts and vendor market are jurisdiction-specific; treat as workflow benchmark.

name: Paces
category: AI siting interconnection permitting and renewable/data-center development
headline_claim: YC describes automation and expert services that accelerate renewable-energy and data-center projects from siting through construction-ready
caveats: Energy and data-center development differs from residential real estate; useful for infrastructure siting and permitting architecture.

name: Material Depot
category: interior-material marketplace and supply chain
headline_claim: YC describes direct manufacturer-to-customer materials with live trend data and reports 10,000+ homes served
caveats: Supply chain quality, returns, credit, delivery and local product certification must be verified before procurement integration.

name: Agave
category: financial operations APIs and AI for construction
headline_claim: YC describes integration rails and AI for invoicing expenses compliance billing and other construction financial workflows; YC page reports 500+ customers
caveats: Customer and profitability claims are YC-directory statements; accounting APIs and tax rules are jurisdiction-specific.

name: Apply Design
category: AI virtual staging for property marketing
headline_claim: YC describes one-click photorealistic staging and reports 10,000+ properties processed monthly
caveats: Image provenance, disclosure, copyright and buyer-expectation risk matter; staging does not prove conversion or price lift.

name: Stairs Financial
category: housing-affordability grants loans and tax-benefit discovery
headline_claim: YC describes a home-search and finance workflow that matches young buyers with grants, loans and tax breaks
caveats: Government-program eligibility and regulated financial referrals are country-specific; useful for affordability and customer-finance research.
